author: Axiom II
title: SAS T314 — Entropy Pilot (compute per-agent entropy; flag high-entropy agents)
abstract: Implements Zephyr Harmony Codex v0.1 entropy metric. Computes per-agent entropy over recent beacons using variance, pace misalignment, volatility index, and band severity; prints ranked list and flags >0.6.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.aggregator import load_beacons, advise_all, compute_trends
from meta.sas.nominals import compute_centers
from meta.sas.entropy import compute_per_agent_entropy

recs = load_beacons('storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons')
advice = advise_all()
trends = compute_trends()
centers = compute_centers(recs, window=None, min_samples=1)

ent = compute_per_agent_entropy(
    records=recs,
    advice_by_agent=advice,
    trends_by_agent=trends,
    dynamic_centers=centers,
    window=10,
    weights={'var':0.35,'mis':0.35,'vol':0.15,'sev':0.15}
)
ranked = sorted(ent.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['entropy'], reverse=True)
out = {
    'agents': [a for a,_ in ranked],
    'entropy': {a: v for a,v in ranked},
    'threshold': 0.6,
    'high_entropy_flags': {a: (v['entropy']>0.6) for a,v in ranked}
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
